tables_2.title:
PART - II

(Brief details of observations made during post-external cleaning examination and repairs/remedial actions taken be highlighted against each serial in this part. Defects/deficiencies remaining outstanding since last examination be also indicated against relevant serials).

cells.value: Steam/Water Drums, Super Heaters/ Economiser Headers Including Inside and Outside Gas Casing. (for deposits, traces of boiler compound around man hole doors, wastage, burning, preservation, and external corrosion, particularly at the interface of water drum and gas casing).
All Accessible Tubes Including Super Heater Tubes throughout their Lengths. (for evidence of deposits, corrosion, overheating, deformation, fouling and indentation/dent marks).
Tube Roots Including those of Super Heater Tubes. (for nature and extent of deposits, signs of any leakage and external corrosion / wastage).
Economiser Elements. (for corrosion, fire damage, wear/tear and accumulation of deposits, particularly at tube bends).
Boiler Mountings. (for soundness of accessible fasteners and ease of operation from local/remote positions, as applicable).
Direct Reading Water Level Indicators and Remote Water Level Indication In ERCR/PDCR/SPDCR. (for completeness, illumination, cleanliness of glasses, ease of operation and comparison).
Safety Valves. (for completeness of hand easing gear, drain pipes, locking arrangement, seals and tally).
Surface and Bottom Blow Down Valves. (for ease of operation and condition).
Blow Down and Super Heater Drain System Pipes. (for corrosion, preservation and state of insulation).
Combustion Registers. (for cleanliness of air, fuel and atomising steam handling components including sighting ports, damages, loose fit, ease of operation and alignment).
Test of Burner Assembly. (Tightness, flow rate and spray test result of burners on test bench. Calibration to be carried out).
Water Drum and Super Heater Headers Supporting stools and Feet. (for security and corrosion/ damage/ preservation).
TBU Inlet Trunking/ Air Space. (for security, obstruction and serviceability of drainage arrangement).
Combustion Air Supply Trunking. (for leakage, lagging, wear/tear, security of supports and obstruction).
Lighting Up Fan Flap and Livers of EBR Ventilation Air Supply Trunking. (for wear & tear and serviceability).

Air and Gas Casing & Joints. (for corrosion, signs of overheating, distortion, crack, preservation, leakage, serviceability of joining, security of tie bars/ stiffeners and possible accumulation of deposits, oil and water).
Boiler Bilge Space Fire Fighting Arrangements. (for wear/ tear and serviceability).
Water Drum & Superheater Dummy Door. (for distortion, leakage, securing arrangement and refractory lining wear).
Uptake and Inner/Outer Funnel Plating, Gratings, Ladders and Access Doors. (for deterioration, damage, deposits, preservation and signs of high temperatures).
Exhaust Duct Expansion Bellow. (for freedom of movement and gas tightness).
Rain Catchment Troughs, Pipe System and Strainers. (for wear/tear and freedom from chockage).
Funnel Cover. (for condition and serviceability of securing arrangement).
Boiler Refractory Chamotte, Silicon Carbide Brickwork, V-Shaped Brick Lining, Register Quarl Etc. (for deterioration, damage, crack, spalling and slagging).
Furnace Access Door Refractory, Economizer Cladding Panels. (for wear/tear and damage).
Furnace Floor Drain System. (for wear/ tear and freedom from chockage).
Furnace Observation Windows and Operating Mechanism. (for ease of operation, cleanliness of glasses and leakage).
Boiler Water Sampling System. (for corrosion, preservation and serviceability).
Boiler Dosing System. (for corrosion, preservation and serviceability).
Radioactive Funnel Smoke Density Indicator. (for cleanliness of indicator ports and serviceability of indicator lamps/equipments).
Flame In/Out Indicator. (for cleanliness of glass/ port and serviceability).
Torch Igniters. (for cleanliness of connector and serviceability /stowage arrangement).

Boiler Instrumentation. (pressure/ temperature gauges and manometers, fitted on/near boiler front and on boiler control panels for completeness and serviceability including ERCR/PDCR/SPDCR. Attach details on separate sheet, if available space is inadequate).
Boiler Warning Alarms and Safety Cutouts. (Serviceability/cold checks of all warning indications & alarms/safety cutouts).
